title: Ultra Condense
description: Lets you further compact blocks like Coal blocks and iron blocks to Condensed blocks
body:
# Ultra Condense

Ultra Condense is a mod that lets you compact compacted blocks further, letting you store 36/81 items in just one block!

## Features

**19 new "ultra condensed" blocks**

These blocks are crafted using 9 already compacted blocks, like Redstone Blocks, Iron Blocks etc.
![GIF demonstrating how to craft the 19 new condensed blocks added by the mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eae8753ec0200402d8b6906573ead65e89288a39.gif)

<details>
<summary>Full list of new blocks</summary>
  
- Condensed Block of Coal
- Condensed Block of Copper
- Condensed Block of Diamond
- Condensed Block of Emerald
- Condensed Block of Gold
- Condensed Block of Iron
- Condensed Block of Lapis Lazuli
- Condensed Block of Netherite
- Condensed Block of Redstone
- Condensed Block of Raw Copper
- Condensed Block of Raw Gold
- Condensed Block of Raw Iron
- Condensed Block of Resin
- Condensed Bone Block
- Condensed Dried Kelp Block
- Condensed Hay Bale
- Condensed Slime Block
- Condensed Honey Block
- Condensed Block of Quartz

</details>

They can be then crafted back into 9 vanilla compacted blocks.

**Quartz Storage**

You can now craft a Block of Quartz using 9 nether quartz, allowing it to be used as a storage block.

**Beacon Support**

You can use the condensed equivalents of beacon mineral blocks to power a beacon.

## Why use this mod

If you have a large amount of a material, you can now easily store it efficiently.
